svg.aria-label: The depth buffer holds one depth per pixel. It starts at 1.0, the far value. The near triangle, depth 0.3, is drawn first and stores 0.3. The far triangle, depth 0.7, comes second and passes the test only where the stored depth is larger, so on the pixels it shares with the near triangle 0.7 is rejected and 0.3 stays.
svg.text: a pixel is drawn only if its depth is less than the stored one
